title: Vault of Ironforge
wikitext:
[[File:Vault of Ironforge.jpg|thumb|380px|The Vault of Ironforge]]

The '''Vault of Ironforge''' is the main [[bank]] and treasure store in the city of [[Ironforge]], located just across from the [[Auction House]] in the [[Commons]] district. Available to members of the [[Alliance]], the bank's services are overseen by [[Dinita Stonemantle|Dinita]] and the Stonemantle family.
